summary: Design a notification module for hold-expiry delivery, kept structurally independent of hold lifecycle rules.
goal: Let hold-expiry notifications (channel, formatting, retry) evolve independently of reservation's core hold lifecycle, without reservation depending on delivery mechanics.

in_scope.text: Define notification as a new module that reads hold-expiry events from reservation, with a forbidden reverse dependency (reservation -> notification)

out_of_scope.text: Implementing the module in src/ — this change stays a structural design artifact; the sample's implementation intentionally remains a single reservation.ts file
Any behavior change, new endpoint, or new OCL/TLA+ contract

success_criteria.text: ArchitecturePlan documents the notification module, the notification -> reservation dependency, and the reservation -> notification forbid_dependency constraint, and passes solidsdd-lint / critique(architecture_plan) cleanly
